# Programming Prompts

Programming Prompts is a prompt library that provides reusable AI coding-agent prompts and engineering guidance for Codex and Claude Code users.

## Canonical pages

- Repository: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/programming_prompts
- README: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/programming_prompts/blob/master/README.md
- General Programming Guidelines: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/programming_prompts/tree/master/skills/general-programming-guidelines
- Commit plugin: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/programming_prompts/tree/master/plugins/commit-guidelines
- Linux desktop configuration plugin: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/programming_prompts/tree/master/plugins/linux-desktop-configuration
- GitHub SEO dispatch skill: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/programming_prompts/tree/master/dispatch-skills/github-seo

## Quickstart

```bash
git clone https://github.com/mikaeltorni/programming_prompts.git
cd programming_prompts
sed -n '1,120p' skills/general-programming-guidelines/SKILL.md
```

## Scope

The repository contains standalone plugin manifests, direct `SKILL.md` prompts,
dispatch skills, and policy tests. It is a content source, not a marketplace
catalog or runtime application.
